note: Two identical lines on table 5. This is the ambiguity that makes automatic reconciliation impossible: the readback carries no OrderedTime and no Printed flag, so nothing in this document says which round put either line there. If round 2 ordered the same item as round 1, an uncertain round 2 cannot be resolved from this. ENVELOPE CAVEAT: the root element carries NO Type attribute here, because the readback response's envelope is NOT SHOWN. IPS.exe's only 'WPPacket Type = ...' literals are the six order-path response bodies (ACK, NAK, DUPLICATE, LOCK, NAKREGO, NAKPRINT); no 'TABLESTATUS' response type exists anywhere in the binary. What IS proven (contract Sec 13) is the per-row <OrderItem> field set, and only that.
